notes.title: Version 2.10 Available Now!
notes.content:
Version 2.10 was released on May 28 and introduces the new playable character Galleon in addition to the content included with Battle Pass Round 8.

[b]Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising – Galleon Gameplay Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=saOTUEfzyPw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Galleon the Gold of the Six Dragons Joins the Roster as a Playable Character![/b]
Galleon is now obtainable as a DLC character.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604390/GBVSR/

[b]Battle Pass Round 8[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37060748/c41755e4d4d2cdb7e7029f8c5a19b380a43b67e6.jpg[/img]

The latest battle pass, Battle Pass Round 8, includes additional in-game items that can be unlocked, such as illustrations, stickers, badges, trophies, and more. A new lobby avatar, Wubbly Galleon, can also be obtained as a battle pass reward.

[url=https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/dlc/battlepass/09]https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/dlc/battlepass/09[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37060748/47846058b8f37ebb87341cf51496a25b66c1812e.png[/img]

[b]Changes to Ranked Matches[/b]
The five-diamond format used previously will be replaced with a numeric point-based system for improved accuracy. Versus ranks will now increase or decrease upon reaching specific point thresholds. The promotion trial system has also been removed with the introduction of the reworked ranked match system.
See the announcement on our official site for more details:
[url=https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=8t3m2l_g3nn0]https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=8t3m2l_g3nn0[/url]

[b]Premium Battle Pass Round 3 Rewards Are Coming Back![/b]
A character costume, character colors, and weapon skins from Round 3 can once again be obtained!
Character Costume
・Seox (Sinborne Redeemer)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604400/GBVSR/

[b]Character Color Set: Battle Pass Pack 3[/b]
• Katalina (Color 22)
• Ladiva (Color 22)
• Ferry (Color 22)
• Vaseraga (Color 22)
• Grimnir (Color 22)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604410/

[b]Weapon Skin Set: Battle Pass Pack 3[/b]
• Narmaya (Confection Cutter)
• Zooey (Ultima Sword)
• Nier (Astral Ring of the Dark Spirit)
• Vane (Mjolnir)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604420/

- This product includes previously released Premium Battle Pass Round 3 rewards. Ensure you are not making a duplicate purchase.

[b]Grand Bruise! Points Added to Grand Bruise Legends! [/b]
A new Grand Bruise! point system has been added. Players can collect points to unlock new rewards.

See the Version 2.10 Patch Notes here:
[url=https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=xr2dnxjz8]https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=xr2dnxjz8[/url]

notes.title: Version 2.00 is Live!
notes.content:
We launched Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising Version 2.00 on February 26, introducing Sandalphon as a playable character. This update also marks the beginning of Battle Pass Round 7 and includes character adjustments and various other new features.

[b]Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising – Sandalphon Gameplay Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=KheKkiZmR6c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Sandalphon, the Primarch of Promises, Descends![/b]
A new playable character, Sandalphon, has been added to the roster of playable characters.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3397140/GBVSR/

[b]Battle Pass Round 7 is Live![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/c6ea389996691054f0b3b87a6eb99f3ed8c92408.png[/img]
With Battle Pass Round 7, players can unlock new rewards such as music, badges, trophies, various in-game items, and a lobby avatar of Ewiyar. 
https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/dlc/battlepass/08
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/f3c77a62996d3dbec3c51fd18a714febe429dda2.png[/img]

[b]Deluxe Character Pass 2 is Here![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44470151/2b8646c3e5ddf1e7ecf2eb60d4a97f75b2e81995.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3287490/GBVSR___Part2/
Sandalphon can also be unlocked via Deluxe Character Pass 2 and Character Pass 2, alongside four other DLC characters that are to be released in future updates.

• Sandalphon (Feb 26, 2025)
• Galleon (Spring 2025)
• Wilnas (Summer 2025)
• Meg (Fall 2025)
• Ilsa (Early 2026)

In addition to unlocking five additional characters as they become available, Deluxe Character Pass 2 comes with 4 color variants and 3 weapon skins for the characters included, the Canaan Shrine stage, and an exclusive Sandalphon (Dark) premium avatar.

[b]Pop Team Epic Has Invaded the Skies of GBVSR![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380200/GBVSR/
Popuko and Pipimi, the beloved protagonists of the popular surreal comedy web comic and animated series Pop Team Epic can now be set as your lobby avatar. Additionally, they can serve as partners to advise and encourage you during gameplay and come with unique profile badges.

[b]Version 2.00 Patch Notes[/b]
https://rising.granbluefantasy.jp/en/news/detail/?id=91-vxmqh-t1x

[h3]Character Adjustments[/h3]
Some adjustments have been made to certain characters.

[u]Charlotta[/u]
Issue – Details
(In Versus and RPG Mode)
Shining Onslaught (Technical Input) – After inputting the command, if the directional input is set neutral or down, the move will no longer come out.

[u]Percival[/u]
Issue – Details
(In Versus and RPG Mode)
Crouching H – The upper hurtbox on startup has been reduced. The hitbox has been increased.
Crouching U – The recovery has been reduced.
Jump H – The startup has been made faster.
X-Seele – Upon a successful throw, the stagger time and the frame advantage time (the time to confirm a hit) have been increased.
[i]*Percival’s recovery has not been changed.[/i]

[u]Metera[/u]
Issue – Details
(In Versus and RPG Mode)
Crouching H – The hitbox on her first active frames has been increased.
Down back H – The upper hurtbox on startup has been reduced, matching her crouching H. The hitbox on her first active frames has also been increased.
Aetherial Seal – When a butterfly is shot with an arrow, the cooldown has been changed where it won’t be overwritten, but paused. After the hitbox has disappeared, the cooldown will continue where it left off.

[u]Lowain[/u]
Issue – Details
(In Versus and RPG Mode)
Close standing M – The recovery has been reduced.
Far standing M – The recovery has been reduced.
Crouching H – The startup has been made faster.

[u]Zeta[/u]
Issue – Details
(In Versus and RPG Mode)
Far standing M – The recovery has been reduced.
Crouching M – The recovery has been reduced.
Close standing H – The recovery has been reduced.
Crouching H – The upper hurtbox on startup has been reduced.  The hitbox has been increased and the recovery has been reduced.
Spear of Arvess (Technical Input) – After inputting the command, if the direction is not held forward, the move will no longer come out.
[i]*The command input is now the same as Lancelot’s Blade Impulse.[/i]
Spear of Arvess (L) – The startup has been reduced.
Spear of Arvess (Rise) (M)
Spear of Arvess (Fall) (M)
Spear of Arvess (Vertical up & down) - Spear of Arvess’ (vertical up & down) hitbox has been expanded.


[u]Vaseraga[/u]
Issue – Details
(In Versus and RPG Mode)
Close standing H – The recovery has been reduced.
Crouching H – The upper hurtbox on startup has been reduced.  The recovery has been reduced.
Crouching U – The recovery has been reduced.
Jump M – The startup has been made faster.
Soul Forge – The startup has been made faster.  The time to gain armor has been made faster. The recovery has been reduced.  Ground stagger and block stun length has been reduced.
[i]*The frame advantage on hit stun and block stun have not been changed.[/i]
Battalions of Fear (Technical Input) – After inputting the command, if the final directional input is neutral or down, the move will no longer come out.
Bloody Moon – The startup has been made faster. The counter state after the attack has been removed.
Aftermath – Even if the lingering active frames hit, as long as the range is close, it will transition into animation.

[u]Beelzebub[/u]
Issue – Details
(In Versus and RPG Mode)
Skill Icon – Langelaan Field’s icon has been fixed to be an invincible icon.

notes.title: Steam Ver. 1.14 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where, under specific conditions, a "Connection was lost" message was displayed in the ranked match standby menu and players were unable to join ranked matches.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Ver. 1.13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue for keyboard users where, in online matches, pressing and holding a key causes that action to be repeated unintentionally.
[*] Fixed an issue for keyboard users where, when a key has been reassigned to a different action from the default, both new and default actions could be input at the same time by the key.
[*] Fixed an issue for keyboard users where inputs from certain keys would no longer be recognized during matches.[/list]

notes.title: Steam Ver. 1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Steam Ver. 1.12 Patch Notes
[list][*] Fixed the following issues with keyboard controls:
[list][*]When a player presses a key at the beginning of a match, the action assigned to a different key will sometimes occur.
[*]If keys are pressed and held before a match begins, those inputs continue even after gameplay begins.[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash if a player presses the Start button to open the button configuration menu when two controllers are connected.
[*] Fixed an issue in RPG mode where the keyboard was always assigned to Player 2 when multiple input devices are connected.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would display the same button icons for Player 2 as Player 1 regardless of which input device Player 2 was using.
[*] Fixed an issue where an incorrect message is shown when selecting “Return” in the Options menu.
[*] Fixed various minor issues.[/list]
